subject: Case study — usage rights, timeline & legal review
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forrester request — quick questions about the case study

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the pointer on the Forrester analyst inquiry. We'd be open to participating in a short case study, but two quick asks before we commit:

1) Can you send the case study questionnaire and proposed timeline?
2) We need confirmation on usage rights — are quotes likely to be published verbatim and will ACME get review rights? Our legal team will want to see it first.

I've looped in Legal Ops who will handle redline questions.

Best,
Priya
Director of Platform Partnerships
ACME Health
[Attachment: ACME_Internal_POI.png (image)]

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forrester request — quick questions about the case study

Hi Priya — really appreciate you considering this. High level answers below, and I'm attaching our standard questionnaire and a draft quote for ACME to review.

- Timeline: draft case study written by us -> review by ACME (5 business days) -> finalization and coordinate analyst briefing (2 weeks from signoff). We can compress if needed.
- Usage rights: Redwood requests non-exclusive rights to publish the case study on our website, sales materials, and in analyst briefings. We always provide a verification review to the customer before publishing; legal redlines are common and we typically accept reasonable edits.

Attached: ACME_CaseStudy_Questions_v1.pdf, Redwood_draft_quote_20270521.pdf

Next steps: if Legal Ops is okay, can we schedule a 30-min call next week to walk through the questionnaire and logistics? Laura from our advocacy team will run the logistics.

Thanks — Sergio
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0142
[Attachment: ACME_CaseStudy_Questions_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Legal Ops <legal@acmehealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forrester request — quick questions about the case study

Sergio / Priya,

Quick read of the questions doc looks fine, but we need the following clarified in writing before we proceed:

1) Confirmation that ACME will have a reasonable review period and final approval of any quotes attributable to our spokespeople.
2) Clarify whether Redwood will share drafts with third parties (e.g., Forrester) prior to ACME sign-off. If so, please list recipients and purpose.
3) Retention and data handling: does Redwood intend to include any telemetry or screenshots that contain PII or patient health data? If yes, we need redaction assurances and an SOC-2 attestation.

If you can provide written confirmation on the above, we can give approval to proceed to the interview stage.

Thanks,
Marta Lopez
Legal Counsel, ACME Health
[Attachment: ACME_Legal_Clearance_Checklist.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <legal@acmehealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forrester request — quick questions about the case study

Hi Marta — thanks for the thoughtful checklist. Short answers inline below: 

1) Review & approval: Absolutely. ACME will receive the full draft and will have five business days for review; quotes attributable to named spokespeople will not be published without explicit written sign-off.

2) Draft sharing: We will not share drafts with Forrester (or other external analysts) prior to ACME sign-off. The only external sharing would be: a) the finalized case study with Forrester as part of the analyst briefing, or b) excerpts with attribution in marketing materials. If the draft must be seen by an analyst for context, that will only happen with ACME's permission.

3) Data handling: Redwood will not include PII or PHI in the case study. Any screenshots that could incidentally include identifiable data will be redacted; we can provide a SOC 2 Type II attestation and a short data handling addendum for the record.

I'll attach the attestation and the short addendum now; Laura will coordinate a scheduling poll for a 30-min interview next week.

— Sergio
[Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (pdf)]
